senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; קבב to hollow out, arch; cmp. גבב,
Kab, a measure of capacity, one sixth of a S’ah.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 11b:10">Sabb. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>הדיוט שהקק קב וכ׳</he> if an unskilled man caves out a Kab in a log (on the Sabbath); [Ar. refers to <cite ref="S00025"><he>קַב</he></cite> 2, v. infra].

<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 5:10">Tosef. B. Bath. V, 10</cite> <he>בכל מקום … קב וכ׳</he> everywhere (in all shops) they must make (keep) measures … of a Kab, half a Kab &c.; <cite ref="Bava Batra 89b:11">B. Bath. 89ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Sotah 8b:16">Sot. 8ᵇ</cite> a. e. <he>קב וחצי קב וכ׳</he> minor measures of sin, v. <cite ref="O00007"><he>סְאָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Challah 2:3:3">Y. Ḥall. II, 58ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>קב טיברני</he> dough of a Tiberian Kab of flour.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 80b:3">B. Mets. 80ᵇ</cite> <he>קב לכתף</he> one Kab (in addition to the load agreed upon) for a carrier is an unlawful overload; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 3:4">Sot. III, 4</cite>, a. e. <he>בקב ותפלות</he>, v. <cite ref="V00834"><he>תִּפְלוּת</he></cite>.
Snh. 29ᵇ (in Chald. dict.) ההוא … קב רשו there was a man whom they nicknamed ‘a Kabful of notes of indebtedness’.—קב ונקי, v. נָקִי I.—Du. קַבַּיִים; pl. קַבִּים, קַבִּין.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 21a:17">B. Mets. 21ᵃ</cite> <he>ק׳ בשמונה וכ׳</he> if one finds two Kabs of fruits scattered within a radius of eight cubits.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Challah 2:3">Ḥall. II, 3</cite> <he>יעשנה ק׳</he> let him make his doughs Kab-wise (so as to be exempt from the priest’s share).
<cite ref="Kiddushin 49b:5">Kidd. 49ᵇ</cite> <he>עשרה ק׳ וכ׳</he> ten measures of &c.
Ber. 22ᵃ תשעה ק׳ nine Kabs of water poured over a person in place of immersion; a. fr.—Denom. קַבִּי, pl. קַבִּיִּים pieces of dough containing a Kab of flour each.
Ḥall. II, 3 אבל ק׳ אין להם חלק בשם (Y. ed. חלה) doughs made of a Kab each have no share in the name of ḥallah

senses.gloss: a piece of wood hollowed out for the stump of a leg, a sort of artificial foot (cmp. אָנְקִטְמִין).
units: Yeb. 102ᵇ (חלצה) בקב הקיטע if a woman performed the ceremony of Ḥălitsah (חֲלִיצָה) by taking off the Yabam’s artificial foot.
Sabb. VI, 8; a. e.—Pl. as ab.
<cite ref="Chagigah 4a:13">Ḥag. 4ᵃ</cite> <he>בעלי ק׳</he> stump-legged persons; a. e.

senses.gloss: cavity, the lower part of a trumpet or horn.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 11:7">Kel. XI, 7</cite> <he>הקב שלה</he> Mish. ed. a. Ar. (Talm. ed. <he>הקו</he>, ed. Dehr. <he>הקב</he>).
